name: spider-silk-benchmark
description: A benchmark focused on evaluating models' ability to produce correct code/queries and associated reasoning in the Spider/Silk-style SQL/code domain. It measures correctness of generated queries both by exact structural match and by execution results against reference databases, enabling analysis of syntactic and semantic correctness. Designed for testing code generation, text-to-SQL conversion, and execution robustness.
reputation: A specialized MIT-associated dataset for SQL/code evaluation with niche use among database and code-generation researchers.
